name: Laces the Chestnut Cat
blurb: Laces, a chestnut-brown shorthair with a thin white stripe down his chest and white toes, chases rolling acorns across the garden lawn.

name: Twirl the Tortie Cat
blurb: Twirl, a tortoiseshell with swirled black and ginger patches and deep gold eyes, turns three slow circles before every nap in the herb bed.

name: Scratch the Silver Cat
blurb: Scratch, a smoky silver cat with a warm gold patch on her chest and copper eyes, sharpens her claws on the old garden post each morning.
